## Publication Information

**Date:** 1778

**Imprint:** London: Beecroft

**Notes:** The Renier collection in the National Art Library, Victoria and Albert Museum, holds CMY's duodecimo copy of <i>The Infant’s Miscellany</i> (?1801),  with ownership inscriptions ‘F.M. Bargus 13 February 1801’ and (erased) ‘C. A. Colborne’ and the bookplate ‘From the Library of Charlotte M. Yonge’.
